newsitem.headline: TABLE - Robotic Vision Q3 shr $0.08.

text.p: Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended

Robert H. Walker, CFO of RVSI, stated, "As mentioned in our two previous quarterly earnings releases, we are seeing a recovery in our largest sector, the semiconductor market, currently accounting for over 60% of our revenues. This recovery has continued solidly for us in the third quarter and right up through the end of July. We achieved record order bookings in the third quarter of over $24 million for our LS- and GS-Series semiconductor lead scanning products, and over $31 million for the overall semiconductor segment of the company when the results of our Systemation unit are included. Lead-times for our semiconductor products have steadily increased and are now at 60-90 days, approaching traditional levels. Overall corporate backlog has increased by over $12 million since the beginning of the fiscal year to $27.1 million on June 30, 1997."

RVSI is the largest company supplying a broad line of both 2-D and 3-D vision-based systems for inspection, measurement and identification, and is a leader in advanced electro-optical sensor technology. Its Acuity Imaging and Northeast Robotics subsidiaries provide 2-D machine vision and lighting solutions, its CiMatrix subsidiary manufactures automated data collection products, networks and 2-D bar code reading systems, and its Systemation subsidiary is a leader in electronic component processing systems. -0-

Pat V. Costa, chairman, president and CEO of RVSI said, "We are pleased that we have not only resumed our revenue growth in the third quarter with total revenues of $37.9 million, but have surpassed our record for quarterly revenues in the process. Our previous high was $36.3 million in the quarter ended Dec. 31, 1995. We are also pleased that we have achieved our first positive year-over-year quarterly pre-tax income comparison since the quarter ended June 30, 1996. The pretax income of $2,658,000 for the third quarter also represents a dramatic increase from the previous quarter ended March 31, 1997 where pre-tax income was $326,000. With the favorable trend we see in our business, we look for continued improvement in our financial performance in the fourth quarter."
